verdict.rationale: Steel publishes an endpoint-by-endpoint API reference ("Explore API endpoints" sections for Captchas, Credentials, Files and more) backed by a live OpenAPI spec. A community user praised the "docs + api ref", which corroborates that a polished reference exists. Nothing in the pack shows that the reference is interactive (e.g., a try-it console) or that it includes runnable examples, so only the reference itself is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of interactive try-it/playground functionality, runnable code examples within the API reference.
